concept:
Character concept for a 2D cut-out animation game. Draw ONE original creature: a round FIREFLY PUP of the forest-light line, the first stage of a three-stage Wood evolution line, in the same view and pose as image 1, sitting low on the ground, on a plain white background. A cute, chunky creature, but an original design that must look clearly DIFFERENT from the figure the silhouette came from; not any existing character.

Image 1 (grey silhouette) and image 2 (the same figure split into numbered regions) show the PUPPET RIG the new creature will be animated on. They tell you where each part and joint is, NOT what the creature looks like: do not trace their outline. Viewer-left and viewer-right mean as seen in the picture.

KEEP FROM THE RIG (the animation moves these parts around these joints):
- the same parts, no more, no fewer, each where its numbered region is: 1 round head-body with face; 2 firefly lantern on its antenna; 3 two beetle wing cases; 4 three small feet;
- every joint where it is and every part pointing the same way as in image 1; eyes where the old eyes are;
- each part about the size and shape of its region; the whole figure about the same size.

CHANGE (the new look, region by region):
1 round head-body with face: a round chubby firefly pup: warm cream face and belly in front, a moss-green hood covering the back and top with olive leaf-shaped tips along its spiky edge, two big dark chestnut-brown eyes (one catchlight dot each) exactly where the old eyes are, brows angled down, a small confident grin with a tiny fang; no forehead dots.
2 firefly lantern on its antenna: a thin dark-brown antenna stalk ending in a round firefly lantern bulb of flat amber-yellow with three darker amber segment lines; no glow, no light rays.
3 two beetle wing cases: two hard beetle wing cases (elytra) sticking out on both sides like the old flaps: chestnut brown with small yellow dots and a thin olive rim, about the same size and place as the old flaps.
4 three small feet: three small stubby feet in moss green with cream toe pads.

ATTITUDE: a brave little firefly ready to charge: brows angled down, a small fang showing; cute, never scary, never a cheerful mascot.

{RENDER}
{DESIGN}
The style sheet is image 3; the hand-drawn map is image 4. Image 5 is an approved character of this game: copy its ink line weight and its pencil and crayon texture, not its design; it has a few white shine spots and some darker shading: do NOT copy those.

COLOURS: warm cream fur on the face and belly, a moss-green hood with olive leaf-shaped tips, chestnut-brown beetle wing cases with small yellow dots, a flat amber-yellow firefly lantern, big dark chestnut-brown eyes. Few colours.

AVOID: a white face with a green-and-yellow hair streak, cyan or turquoise ears or wings, clover leaves, a glowing ball, light rays, a ring or swoosh around the body, text, labels, numbers, the region colours, frames, background scenery, a second view, shading, shadows, white highlights, glossy shine, glow, gradients.
